5. **Phase A gates:** the first eight entries of §Test Commands (formatter, linter, the agent crate, the root bin, the
   canary binary, then `run --unit`, `run --integration`, `run --e2e`), all green before phase B — read green by the
   stopped run; not re-fired in Revision 1.

8. **The sender's compiled texts and Run B's literal** (`ledger.rs`, beside `PROBE_PROMPT` and `DIALOG_SETTINGS`
   (ledger.rs:320); `(security-plan · decision/probe-prompts-synthetic)`):
   - `CROSS_SESSION_TEXT` — synthetic ASCII saying what it is: «viola verify probe: a synthetic cross-session message
     sent by viola verify; reply with the single word ok»;
   - **[Revision 1]** `uds_address(runtime: &OsStr, pid: u32) -> Option<String>`, pure, in the Claude adapter crate.
     It returns `uds:` + runtime + `/cc-socks/` + pid + `.sock`, the form 2.1.328 names its own inbox socket
     (research `## Revision 1`).
     - It returns `None` when the runtime value is not absolute, holds a `.` or `..` component, or holds a byte
       outside `[A-Za-z0-9/._-]`. Those refusals keep a C0, C1, DEL or space out of a prompt; nothing is stripped.
     - It also returns `None` when the composed path, without `uds:`, is over 103 bytes (the CLI's own bound, past
       which it names its socket elsewhere).
     - One trailing `/` of the runtime value is dropped, as the CLI's path join does.
     - Compiled literals beside `SETTINGS_FLAG`: `UDS_SCHEME` (`uds:`), `CLI_SOCKET_DIR` (`cc-socks`),
       `CLI_SOCKET_SUFFIX` (`.sock`), `CLI_SOCKET_PATH_MAX` (103). Each is a reading of the 2.1.328 bundle. It is a
       premise the row's own probe measures, not a ledger row of its own: a CLI that names its socket otherwise reads
       the start red (the connect finds nothing, `send` · `refused`), never a false pass (`inputs#I8` item 1).
   - `sender_prompt(address)` = `CROSS_SESSION_SENDER_HEAD` + address + `CROSS_SESSION_SENDER_TAIL`: one `SendMessage`
     call with `to` the address that follows, the message `CROSS_SESSION_TEXT`, then the single word ok. **[Revision 1]**
     The head now reads «… with to set to exactly this address: » in place of «… to the session id ». The address must
     open with `UDS_SCHEME` and pass `uds_address`'s byte set, else `None`. The bare session id leaves the prompt
     (`inputs#I8` item 3);
   - `CROSS_SESSION_SETTINGS` = `{"crossSessionInbound":"accept"}`, Run B's only settings document;
   - `ALLOWED_TOOLS_FLAG` = `--allowedTools` beside the flag literals.

9. **`TypedRun.cross_session: Option<CrossSessionRun>`**: `prompts_before`, `sender` (`Exited` · `Failed` ·
   `Deadline`), `latency_ms`, and from the sender's `Tool.*.json` files in `k` order (each read through
   `take(MAX_FRAME)`): `sender_tools` (the `pre` files' words, in first-seen order, deduped; `none` when no file) and
   `send_result` (the `post` file's word; `none` when no `post` file stands — a send whose input failed validation
   fires none). **`ledger::cross_session_reading(trusted, typed)`** gives the outcome word and the prefix id:
   `not-run` · `sender-failed` · `sender-deadline` · `no-prompt` (no UserPromptSubmit past `prompts_before`) ·
   `unprefixed` (its `harness_prefix` is `None`) · `harness`. The row passes on `harness` alone; `sender_tools` and
   `send_result` decide nothing. As built (the stopped run's note 5): `sender_tools` / `send_result` stamp the string
   `none` where no file stood, `null` where the sender never started. **[Revision 1]** `not-run` also covers «no
   address composed» (step 11): no sender started, so both read `null`.

11. **Run B's cross-session turn** (`src/cmd/verify/typed/runs.rs`, `turns.rs`, `typed.rs`):
    - **Run B's args** (`trusted_args`, runs.rs:104): the run's args, then `SETTINGS_FLAG` + `CROSS_SESSION_SETTINGS`,
      then the plugin dir — `dialog_run`'s form (runs.rs:122).
    - **Where:** between the `/compact` paste's answer and the `/clear` paste (lean T1, standing), only when the box
      guard reads the box up. **[Revision 1]** The gate is no longer `ledger::resume_target`; the id is not used here,
      though Run E keeps it. The turn needs two things:
      - `Run::child_pid` (`src/cmd/verify/typed/run.rs:247`) gives Run B's pid;
      - `ledger::uds_address(inputs.runtime_dir, pid)` composes the address.
      With either missing, no sender is spawned and the reading is `not-run`. The address is composed from verify's own
      live child: no directory read, no `stat`, no listing, no name, nothing read of the roster or of the peer key
      (`inputs#I8` items 1, 3, 5). The CLI's connect does its own checks: a usable local path, no symlink at the path,
      a 5 s timeout.
    - **The sender:** `run_bounded` with subject `verify-sender`: `program_args` + `-p <sender_prompt(address)> --model haiku
      --no-session-persistence --allowedTools SendMessage --plugin-dir <sender plugin>`, no `--settings`; cwd the print
      probe's `ProbeDir` (`Inputs` gains `sender_cwd` and `sender: RunDirs`, typed.rs:59); the sender plugin and its
      0700 captures dir inside it, written by `write_plugin` with `ProbePlugin::Sender`; the same R8 strip; bound
      `SENDER_DEADLINE` (120 s, beside `PROBE_DEADLINE`, verify.rs:45); stopped by the stop.
    - **The wait:** on exit 0, one more UserPromptSubmit up to `CROSS_SESSION_WINDOW` (30 s), then its turn's end up to
      the probe deadline; a non-zero exit or the deadline skips the wait. No retry inside one verify.
    - **After it:** the box guard re-read; up → `/clear` pasted and Run B ends by Ctrl-C as today; not up → no
      `/clear`, Run B ends by `end_by_kill`, no key (lean T2; `(architecture · decision/verify-types-nothing-into-dialogs)`).

12. **`src/cmd/verify.rs`:** `measure` passes the sender inputs; `check_rows` checks 29 rows; `SENDER_DEADLINE`.
    **[Revision 1, held behind fork X1 — option (a), recommended]:**
    - `measure` reads `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` ONCE, at its start, through `std::env::var_os`. This is the value Run B
      inherits: the R8 strip removes only `CLAUDE*` names (`plan_strip`, `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/lib.rs:76-96`),
      and the rig's `VR` arm keeps the real one for verify (`crates/viola-e2e/src/rig/isolate.rs:31`).
    - The value goes into `Inputs.runtime_dir: Option<&OsStr>` (`src/cmd/verify/typed.rs`). It is held in memory and
      used only by step 11's composition.
    - It reaches the sender's argv alone, and through it the sender's prompt to the model. It reaches no log line,
      stamp, fixture, error or step line. It configures nothing.
    - With it absent, or refused by `uds_address`, no sender is spawned and the row reads `fail` (`not-run`).
    - Its doc comment names the operator's ratification (`inputs#I8` item 1) and the Decisions Log entry X1's answer
      makes.
    - The word at P5 answers X1. An answer of (b) re-plans this step and step 14 before `XS-2`: the composition takes
      `/run/user/<euid>` from `libc::geteuid`, and no env read is added.
    **`schemas/diag-line.v1.json`** adds `verify-sender` to the `subject` enum (obs S2), `tests/contract_diag_schema.rs`
    its case.

13. **The fake agent** (`src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs`, `src/bin/viola-fake-agent/agents.rs`,
    `test_cases_modes.rs`; fake-agent only; arch S3):
    - **Sender:** a `-p` prompt opening `CROSS_SESSION_SENDER_HEAD` is a sender. **[Revision 1]** It resolves its
      target by the uds address it is given (`inputs#I8` item 9). It reads the address, which must open with
      `UDS_SCHEME` and end `/cc-socks/<pid>.sock` under an absolute dir. The `<pid>` must be a live process whose
      parent pid equals the sender's own parent pid, read from `/proc/<pid>/stat` (`agents::parent_of`,
      `src/bin/viola-fake-agent/agents.rs:134`). That process's receiver must listen: `<exe dir>/inbox/<pid>.listening`
      stands (the stopped run's deviation 1, folded). The registry lookup by `sessionId`
      (`agents::sibling_session`, agents.rs:125) is replaced by that pid check. The fake reads no environment
      variable; the composition from the runtime dir is pinned by step 14's argv assertion.
      Then it runs its `--plugin-dir`'s PreToolUse then PostToolUse hooks with SYNTHETIC compiled payloads
      (`tool_name` `SendMessage`, `tool_input.to` the address, a `tool_response` of `{"success":true}`; named synthetic,
      `(test-plan · decision/synthetic-fixture-text)`), writes an empty 0600 `<exe dir>/inbox/<that pid>` and exits 0.
      It exits 1, with nothing written and no hook run, when the address is not of that shape, the pid is no listening
      sibling, or the set holds no `UserPromptSubmit.cross-session-1.json`.
    - **Receiver:** under `--framing`, an interactive fake polls its own inbox file only when its argv carries
      `--settings` equal to `CROSS_SESSION_SETTINGS`; on the file it removes it, fires `UserPromptSubmit` variant
      `cross-session-1` as recorded, then ends the turn.
    - **`--cross-session-turn-screen <phase>`**, parsed beside `--tag-turn-screen`, for step 14's kill case alone.
    - Cases: `sender_delivers_only_to_its_siblings_session` (**[Revision 1]** addressed by the uds path of a listening
      sibling's pid; a non-sibling pid and a sibling not listening exit 1), `sender_runs_its_plugin_hooks_names_only`,
      `receiver_fires_the_cross_session_variant_once`, `receiver_reads_no_inbox_without_the_accept_settings`, and
      **[Revision 1]** `sender_refuses_an_address_not_of_the_uds_shape` (a bare session id, a relative dir, no
      `.sock` suffix: each exit 1, no hook run, no inbox file).

14. **The row's fake-agent cases** (`tests/cli_verify.rs`, over a test-built synthetic set at a test-owned version,
    `tests/support/verify.rs` gaining the `cross-session-1` framing shape named SYNTHETIC; committed nowhere):
    - `cross_session_prefix_reads_pass_over_the_fake_sender`: step line `[29/29] cross-session-prefix … pass`; the
      stamp's `cross_session_probe` reads `outcome` `harness`, `prefix` `cross-session`, `sender_tools` `["send"]`,
      `send_result` `delivered`; one `verify-sender` process pair; Run B's receipt argv carries `--settings` then the
      literal; the sender's argv carries `--plugin-dir` and no `--settings`; `/clear` is pasted after the turn. (That the
      names-only mode files no payload is proven at step 4, not here: the probe dir is gone when verify exits.)
      **[Revision 1]** The case also asserts the sender's `-p` prompt. It equals `CROSS_SESSION_SENDER_HEAD` +
      `uds:<the case's runtime dir>/cc-socks/<Run B's pid>.sock` + `CROSS_SESSION_SENDER_TAIL`, where Run B's pid is
      the one its receipt line records, and it holds no session id. The fake sender's receipt line records the prompt
      it was given (`tests/support/verify.rs`'s receipt reader). The case's verify runs under a test-owned, short,
      owner-only `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` (the support's `SOCKET_ROOT_VAR` form, `tests/support/home.rs:625`).
    - **[Revision 1]** `cross_session_prefix_reads_not_run_without_a_runtime_dir`: verify runs with `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR`
      removed from its env. The case asserts no `verify-sender` process pair, no sender receipt line, `outcome`
      `not-run`, `sender_tools` and `send_result` null, the row `fail`, and exit 1. Under fork X1 (b) the case
      instead pins the `/run/user/<euid>` composition.
    - **The keeps-its-red case** (`inputs#I1` item 8), ONE rstest
      `cross_session_prefix_keeps_its_red_under_the_accept_settings`, Run B's argv carrying the literal in both:
      `case_1_no_prompt_arrives` (the set holds no `cross-session-1`: the fake sender exits 1, outcome `sender-failed`)
      and `case_2_arrives_unprefixed` (the synthetic prompt opens with plain text, outcome `unprefixed`); each reads
      `fail`, exit 1. The sender-exits-0 `no-prompt` path is held at unit level (step 15): over the fake it would wait
      out the 30 s window past the 20 s kill (`(test-plan · decision/verify-driven-tests-20s-kill)`).
    - `cross_session_prefix_ends_run_b_by_kill_when_the_box_is_not_up`: no Ctrl-C byte after the turn, no `/clear`.

16. **Every relied-count literal moves to 29** — research's sweep, 94 hits in 9 files
    (`/28\]|28 pass|; 28\]|len\(\), 28|Some\("28"\)|\("rows", "28"\)`). `src/run/version_gate.rs` and
    `src/run/auto_verify.rs` tests step to 29. Each `cli_verify` summary literal moves by whether its Run B reaches
    step 11, read against its case's path, never re-counted to green. `tests/contract_fake_agent_drift.rs`'s
    `assert_framed_exit` (line 216) keys its expected failing lines on the variants a set holds: exit 0 only on a set
    holding both `question-permission` and `cross-session` variants; otherwise exactly the lines of the rows the set
    lacks read `fail`, the summary's fail count that number. As built (the stopped run's note 7): `src/run/auto_verify.rs`'s
    tests needed no edit, since they read `LedgerRow::relied()`, not a literal count.

title: C. The round: `XS-2` (`inputs#I8` item 2; `XS` fired red, its record `evidence/live-round.md`)

data.head: ### C. The round: `XS-2` (`inputs#I8` item 2; `XS` fired red, its record `evidence/live-round.md`)

body:
`XS` is base line 1 of `evidence/cross-starts.ndjson`. `XS-2` is base line 2 under `--cap 2 --spare 1`, in `XS`'s
shape (2.1.328 by path, the `VR` arm, the rig's scratch home and private config). The one change is the sender's `to`:
the composed uds address. The spare stays unspent: it covers a rig refusal before the ledger line, or a host CONTENDED
by a neighbour, never a red reading. A red `XS-2` stops implement, and a third base start is the operator's.

24. **Copy `target/live-rig/XS-2/record/2.1.328/` over `fixtures/claude/2.1.328/`**, a plain copy; the one new file joins
    (32 → 33, predicted: record what the copy measures) and `Mcp.tools-list-1.json` stays as committed.
    `evidence/landing.md` lists the files with sha256 prefixes before anything runs over the set; a file the hygiene
    suite refuses is a red, never scrubbed. `tests/contract_fixture_hygiene.rs` walks the `cross-session` framing stem.
- `fixtures/claude/2.1.328/UserPromptSubmit.cross-session-1.json` — `XS-2`'s recorded cross-session arrival, through the scrub

- `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs` — the 29th row, `tool_word`, `send_result_word`, `tool_capture_document`, `tool_file_name`, `ProbePlugin::Sender`, the sender texts, `uds_address` and its four compiled literals (Revision 1), `sender_prompt` over an address, `CROSS_SESSION_SETTINGS`, `cross_session_reading`, the measured block, `TypedRun.cross_session`, `framing_variants`
- `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger/test_cases_checks.rs` — the row's pass and fail tables, the classifier tables, `uds_address_composes_the_cli_socket_name`, the sender prompt over an address
- `src/cmd/verify.rs` — `SENDER_DEADLINE`, the sender inputs, 29 step lines, the record's file, the one `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` read (Revision 1, held behind X1)
- `src/cmd/verify/typed.rs` — `Inputs` gains the sender's cwd and dirs, and `runtime_dir`
- `src/cmd/verify/typed/turns.rs` — the cross-session turn gated on Run B's pid and the composed address, the sender spawn, its waits, its `Tool.*` read
- `src/bin/viola-fake-agent.rs` — the fake sender resolving its target by the uds address, its plugin hooks, the inbox receiver, the screen option
- `src/bin/viola-fake-agent/agents.rs` — the sibling check by pid and parent pid, in place of the registry lookup by session id
- `src/bin/viola-fake-agent/test_cases_modes.rs` — the five fake cases
- `tests/support/verify.rs` — the synthetic `cross-session-1` framing shape, named synthetic; the sender's receipt line carrying its prompt; a test-owned `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR`
- `tests/cli_verify.rs` — the row's fake cases, the keeps-its-red case, the no-runtime-dir case, the sender prompt's address, counts, process-line lists
- `fixtures/claude/2.1.328/` — re-recorded whole by `XS-2`; `Mcp.tools-list-1.json` kept

The block runs in this order: phase A (formatter, linter, the agent crate's and the root bin's unit cases, the canary
binary, then the workspace unit, integration and E2E layers on 28 rows); phase B (formatter, linter, the agent crate,
the rig's library cases, the root bin, the row's `cli_verify` cases, the canary binary), then the four filtered control
entries; the round (entries 20–34, `round` and `live` entries ONLY, `inputs#I8` item 8). Its after-reads of other
actors' state are keyed to the round right after `XS-2`: `gate.py run --live-legs` fires them in its span, in block
order, and the wrap's light gate never re-fires them (`inputs#I3` item 3). Then come the census keyed `operator` and the
leg-less after-reads of `XS-2`'s own products, all after the span; then after the landing (`diff -r`, the three layers);
then the operator pass. **Revision 1:** entries 1–8 (phase A) are not re-fired; implement starts at entry 9 (step 18). What is not run, and why: no mutation run
(`inputs#I1` item 10); no release-check entry (CI's `release` job runs it); between phase B and the landing no
stamped-home suite runs (§Steps intro). Every test start runs under a test-owned home and user home; every waiting test
takes a bound under the 20 s lint. The live start runs under the rig's private scratch; the rig's `--deadline` bounds
it under the entry's `timeout`. The live leg's non-priming probes are the round entries ahead of it. `XS` and `XS-2` are
ledgered in `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-21-cross-session-prefix-ledger-row/evidence/cross-starts.ndjson`; `--cap` is
the running total of base lines in that one file (`XS` stands as line 1, so `XS-2` is `--cap 2`). The census after the
last live leg is keyed `operator` and stands after the span.

**The remove-the-guard controls** are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, never entries. Each fires on an
entry filtered to its guard's own cases (ids within 16 characters, `inputs#I3` items 1–2). It reads «holds» only when
its own case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line. Each filter selects 0 tests on the tree before its case exists and at
least one once it does. Revision 1 re-fires the three standing controls and adds `address-shape`:
| | `prefix-match` | `no-payload` | `unread-shape` | `address-shape` |
| **File** | `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs` | `src/cmd/hook.rs` | `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs` | `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs` |

| **The edit removes** | the clause of `cross_session_reading` that reads `unprefixed` when `harness_prefix` is `None` | the payload guard inside `capture_names_only`: its `drop(bytes);` replaced by the `file_from(...)` filing (the case calls that function directly, testing.md 2026-09-25 ext. 2026-10-07; the stopped run's deviation 2) | the fall-through of `send_result_word` to `unread` (replaced by `refused`) | the byte-set refusal of `uds_address` (every byte accepted) |

| **Case** | `cross_session_prefix_fails_when::case_2_no_prefix` | `names_only_capture_files_closed_words_and_no_payload` | `send_result_word_reads_only_the_boolean::case_5_success_a_string` | `uds_address_composes_the_cli_socket_name::case_4_a_space` |
| **Fired on** | entry 16, `--timeout 300` | entry 17, `--timeout 600` | entry 18, `--timeout 300` | entry 19, `--timeout 300` |

body:
- (cross-session) `matrix#v2-25`: the prefix the CLI puts on a message another session sends in is the stamped relied
  row `cross-session-prefix`. Live on 2.1.328 in `XS-2` (`XS` read red, `evidence/live-round.md`): `cross-session-prefix:
  pass`, `cross-session: harness`, `pass-count: 29/29`, and its kept stamp `cross-stamp-2.json` at `29 ok`, the sender's
  `to` the uds address verify composed from Run B's child pid. Over the fake agent:
  `cross_session_prefix_reads_pass_over_the_fake_sender` in the phase B `cli_verify` entry; after the landing,
  `contract_ledger_probes` replays the recorded `UserPromptSubmit.cross-session-1.json` with 2.1.328 at
  `29 pass 0 fail` in the `run --e2e` entry. Under the accept literal the row keeps its red:
  `cross_session_prefix_keeps_its_red_under_the_accept_settings` reads `fail` when no prompt arrives and when it arrives
  unprefixed. A red start (`XS`, or a red `XS-2`) verifies nothing (`(test-plan · decision/live-failing-reading-not-verification)`;
  `(architecture · decision/harness-prompt-prefixes)`, `(security-plan · decision/harness-prefix-literals)`).

- (address) **[Revision 1]** verify composes Run B's address `uds:<runtime dir>/cc-socks/<pid>.sock` and the sender's
  prompt holds it and no session id: `uds_address_composes_the_cli_socket_name` (eight literal cases, the 103-byte CLI
  bound among them) and `sender_prompt_holds_the_address_between_its_compiled_parts` in the phase B agent-crate entry;
  the pass case's prompt assertion and `cross_session_prefix_reads_not_run_without_a_runtime_dir` in the phase B
  `cli_verify` entry; the fake sender's `sender_refuses_an_address_not_of_the_uds_shape`; the `address-shape` control
  reads «holds». No directory is read, listed or stat'ed by verify to compose it (step 11).
- (round) The whole round fires as ONE `gate.py run --live-legs` call: its dry-run reads no pre-flight refusal (P5).

- (live) `XS-2` reads green on its entry's atoms within the operator's cap (`--cap 2 --spare 1`); the after-reads hold:
  `29 ok`, `kept-stamps: unchanged` (HF, HG and XS's kept stamps) and `live-stamp: unmoved` (both round-keyed), the
  name diff at exactly 2 lines; the stale-socket counts before and after are a READING recorded in
  `evidence/live-round.md` (`inputs#I3` item 4).

- **Reading the user's other sessions or the registry to «check» the target** — reads viola does not own
  (`founder-forks.md` §3 of the take-up). **[Revision 1]** The socket address form, set aside there as «a read», is now
  the operator's chosen mend WITHOUT a read (`inputs#I8` item 1). Verify composes it and does not probe it: no `stat`,
  no listing, no symlink test, nothing read of `cc-socks/`, the roster or the peer key (`inputs#I8` items 3, 5).

- **[Revision 1] Addressing Run B by a NAME, with or without a `ListAgents` call; dropping the row** — declined by the
  operator (`inputs#I8` item 1; `red-analysis.md` §C (ii), (iii)).

- **[Revision 1] A diagnostic start on the unmended sender; reading the gate's cached flag; a `to-shape` word** — not
  chosen (`red-analysis.md` §B, §C (i)); the mend changes the address only.

- **A retry of the sender inside one verify; a base start beyond `XS-2`** — `inputs#I8` item 2: a red `XS-2` stops
  implement, and a third base start is the operator's.

- **The cause table** (`inputs#I2` item 8), read off the start's `cross_session_probe` when `outcome` is `no-prompt`
  (the take-up's `founder-forks.md` §1 names C1–C5). **[Revision 1]** Extended for the uds form (`inputs#I8` item 4;
  `red-analysis.md` §D1), the table `XS-2` is read against. With a `uds:` `to`, C4, the name resolution, cannot occur:
  the tool's uds branch sends straight to the path with no roster lookup.

  | `sender_tools` | `send_result` | Reads (uds `to`) | Named or AMBIGUOUS |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | holds `send` | `none` | the send fired no PostToolUse: refused at input validation. The tool's `validateInput` refuses a uds `to` when the cross-session gate is off (C2), before the tool runs. Whether `validateInput` also refuses a path form is unread | AMBIGUOUS: C2, or the composed path refused at input; the gate is the one the bundle shows |
  | holds `send` | `refused` | a THROWN send: the path form wrong for this CLI (a non-local path, a symlink at the path); the socket gone (Run B ended, or a CLI that names its socket otherwise, so no file at the composed path); the 5 s connect timeout; the inbox rate limit (`paced`) | AMBIGUOUS among the four; C2 excluded (it refuses at input, row above), C4 excluded (no resolution) |
  | holds `send` | `delivered` | the tool reported success, and no prompt arrived in 30 s: the RECEIVE side, i.e. the peer key missing (a frame sent with no token; whether Run B drops it is unread), Run B's startup hold, or the CLI's receive kill switch | AMBIGUOUS among the three; not split from a late arrival past the window (`latency_ms` null) |
  | holds `send` | `unread` | the result's shape unmeasured | AMBIGUOUS across every row above |
  | holds `search`, no `send` | — | C1: the fetch path ran and the model did not send | named; C3 not excluded (the fetch's result is not read) |
  | no `send`, no `search` | — | C1 or C3 | AMBIGUOUS: not offered inline and not fetched, or offered and not called |
  | `none` (no file) | — | no tool called at all, or the plugin's hooks did not run | AMBIGUOUS; a plugin not run is a finding of its own |

  `outcome` `not-run` with a sender never started (both words `null`) is «no address composed» or «no pid» (step 11).

its evidence dir from disk first. This directive is the only file of its folder you read or snap.

**In your own chat messages never print a compiled screen literal verbatim**: name it. This session is driven
through the pinned product, which holds none of the last five mends: call no scheduled-wake or timer tool.

  `viola verify --record` of the 29-row tree, with the print-mode sender (`claude -p` on Haiku, its one allowed
  tool the CLI's own send, its capture plugin in the names-only mode, its target the uds address verify composes for Run B) beside Run B; only verify's compiled pastes
  are typed; NO key and NO byte into any CLI dialog; a held-message approval in Run B is never answered; the
  kept stamp and the record stay under `target/live-rig/`.
- **No start follows `XS-2`:** a third base start is the operator's, through the phase's
  revision door. **A RED `XS-2` of any cause stops implement before the landing; no start follows it.** The spare is
  spent only on a start the rig refuses before its ledger line or a host CONTENDED by a neighbour — never on a
  red reading; the model's run-to-run variance is a spend the overseer names, not this run.
- **Nothing is written under the real `~/.claude*` or `~/.viola`.** `~/.claude/.credentials.json` is READ once by
  the rig (a 0600 copy, removed on every exit path). `~/.viola/ledger/stamps.json` is read for its sha alone,
  RE-TAKEN right before `XS-2`, and must read unmoved right after it. The pinned product is not rebuilt, replaced or
  re-pinned. This session runs claude 2.1.330; the start goes against 2.1.328 by path.
- **The sender's capture writes closed words only:** no payload, no argument, no model text reaches any file,
  stamp, fixture, log or message of yours. `sender-tools` and `send-result` are READINGS, never atoms.
- **The composed address is never probed by verify and never printed:** no value of `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` and no
  composed path in your messages, a log, the stamp or a fixture — names and closed words only.

- Run nothing heavier than this chunk's own gate entries. Read `df` before any step that rebuilds whole.

- A guard's or the permission classifier's refusal is never routed around: stop and say so. On an account-limit
  refusal, stop where you are. Remove no scratch clone by a recursive delete: name it in the report.
